aboutText: With over 30 years of experience serving Hillside and surrounding areas, PP Appliances provides expert appliance repair services. Our technician, Peter, is known for his quick diagnostics and efficient solutions, as seen in his recent work on a Simpson washing machine. We pride ourselves on quiet, professional service that gets your appliances running smoothly again.
servicesText: At PP Appliances, we offer a wide range of repair services for household appliances. From washing machines to refrigerators, our experienced team ensures quick and reliable fixes to keep your home running smoothly.

services.title: Washing Machine Repair
services.desc: Expert diagnostics and repairs for all washing machine brands, including Simpson and others.

services.title: Dryer Repair
services.desc: Fixing tumble dryers and clothes dryers to ensure efficient drying cycles.

services.title: Dishwasher Repair
services.desc: Comprehensive repair services for dishwashers, from leaks to electrical faults.

services.title: Oven & Stove Repair
services.desc: Professional repairs for ovens, stoves, and cooktops to restore cooking performance.

services.title: Refrigerator Repair
services.desc: Keeping your fridge cool with fast repairs for cooling issues and malfunctions.

services.title: General Appliance Maintenance
services.desc: Preventative maintenance services to extend the life of your household appliances.
